name: get_customer
description: Retrieve a customer profile using customer ID and optionally email address

customer_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer

email.description: The customer's email address (optional, for exact match)

name: query_by_region
description: Query customers by geographic region (Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, South, Southwest, West, Northwest, Mountain)

region.description: The geographic region to filter by

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 50)

name: query_by_tier
description: Query customers by subscription tier (Free, Basic, Standard, Premium, Enterprise), sorted by monthly spend

subscription_tier.description: The subscription tier to filter by

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 50)

name: batch_get_customers
description: Retrieve all customer records from the database

name: scan_customers
description: Scan the customers table with pagination to retrieve all records

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page (default: 50)

last_evaluated_key.description: The pagination key from previous scan to continue from
